name: Candescent
author: Ignition72

sections.description:
Candescent by Ignition72 is a sophisticated accessibility plugin designed to enhance web accessibility for all users. This powerful front-end tool offers both public and admin-only features to ensure your website is inclusive and user-friendly.

Public Accessibility Tools:

  • Toggle High Contrast: Provides a high contrast mode to improve readability for visually impaired users.
  • Toggle Page Zoom: Enlarges text and other elements for easier reading and navigation.
  • Toggle Focus State: Highlights the current focus point on the page, aiding navigation for users with keyboard or screen readers.
  • Toggle Link Highlights: Visually emphasizes all available links to facilitate easier navigation.

Admin-Only Accessibility Tools:

  • Check Images: Detects and marks images that lack descriptive alt tags, ensuring all visuals are accessible.
  • Check Color Contrast: Identifies contrast issues, such as insufficient contrast between text and background, to improve readability.
  • Check Links and Buttons: Verifies that all links and buttons have appropriate text and ARIA labels, enhancing navigability for screen readers.
  • Check for Duplicate IDs: Detects duplicate IDs on the page, ensuring unique identification of elements for accessibility compliance.

Candescent, developed by Ignition72, is dedicated to making the internet a more inclusive and accessible space for everyone.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Candescent plugin to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory,
    or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
